paths.name: Path of Khaine
paths.description: A mastery path focused on offence and greatswords.

ability.name: Deep Incision
ability.description: Quick Incision will now inflict an additional 628 damage over 10 seconds.

ability.name: Phoenix's Wing
ability.description: A broad slash that hits all opponents 25 feet in front of you for 175 Spirit damage.

ability.name: Balanced Accuracy
ability.description: Increases your chance to critically hit by 10% while you have Improved Balance, or 20% while you have Perfect Balance.

ability.name: Ether Dance
ability.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
Requires Great Weapon
ability.description: You focus on your target, slashing repeatedly for up to 3 seconds, striking them up to five times and dealing 258 Spirit damage with each hit.

ability.name: Great Weapon Mastery
ability.description:
When you are wielding a great weapon, your chance to parry is increased by 5% and all damage you deal is increased by 10%.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Sapping Strike
ability.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
Requires Great Weapon
ability.description: A targeted strike that saps the energy from your target, dealing 655 Spirit damage over 10 seconds and increases your chance to critically hit by 10% for 10 seconds. If you strike your target from behind you instantly deal an additional 231 Spirit damage.

ability.name: Whirling Geyser
ability.description: A spinning attack that inflicts 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet and then knocks them straight up.

coreAbilities.name: Quick Incision
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
coreAbilities.description: A rapid slash to your opponents legs that deals 156 damage and snares them by 40% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Blurring Shock
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
coreAbilities.description: A powerful slash that deals 194 Spirit damage. For the next 10 seconds, each time the target is critically hit, they take an additional 112 Spirit damage.

coreAbilities.name: Gryphon's Lash
coreAbilities.description: A fierce attack that deals 194 damage and cannot be Blocked or Parried.

coreAbilities.name: Nature's Blade
coreAbilities.description:
You enchant your blade with the spirit of nature. All your melee attacks gain a 25% chance to randomly steal 100 stat points from targets within 30 feet of you for 10 seconds. During this time, both you and groupmates within 100 feet will benefit from the stolen stats.

You may only have 1 Blade Enchantment active at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Wall of Darting Steel
coreAbilities.description: You spin your greatsword with astounding speed, forming a wall of steel between you and your opponent. Your chances to Dodge, Disrupt and Parry attacks are increased by 50%, and whenever you defend against an attack, you will reflect back 262 Spirit damage.

paths.name: Path of Vaul
paths.description: A mastery path focused on defence and protection.

ability.name: Perfect Defenses
ability.description: Increase Block chance by 5% when in Normal Balance, 10% when in Improved Balance, and 15% when in Perfect balance.

ability.name: Redirected Force
ability.note: Requires Block, Disrupt, Dodge, or Parry.
ability.description: Redirects the force of a defended blow into a devastating attack dealing 170 damage to all enemies within 20 feet in front of you, interrupting any spells they are casting and generating a large amount of additional hate from monsters.

ability.name: Vaul's Buffer
ability.description: On a successful Block, Parry, Dodge or Disrupt you will absorb up to 600 damage over the next 10 seconds. This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Crushing Advance
ability.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
Requires Shield
ability.description: A calculated shield maneuver that inflicts 194 damage to all enemies 15 feet in front of you. Additionally, for the next 20 seconds, your block rate is increased by 10% and your armor will be increased by 594 points.

ability.name: Raking Talons
ability.description: Dragon's Talon now additionally affects all enemies within 20 feet of your target.

ability.name: Vaul's Tempering
ability.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
ability.description: An enchantment which calls upon the power of Vaul, giving Unstoppable and Immovable and reducing incoming damage by 10% to yourself and any of your group mates within 30 feet of you for 6 seconds.

ability.name: Shield of Valor
ability.description: Everyone in your group regains 200 action points and is protected by a magical barrier for 15 seconds which will absorb up to 4500 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Eagle's Flight
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
coreAbilities.description: A guarded strike that deals 194 damage and improves your chance to parry by 20% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Phantom's Blade
coreAbilities.description:
You enchant your blade with the spirits of the dead. All your melee attacks have a 25% chance to increase your group's Wounds by 50 for 10 seconds. Anyone affected will be healed for the amount increased.

You may only have 1 Blade Enchantment active at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Graceful Strike
coreAbilities.description: A swift attack that deals 97 damage and an additional 185 damage over 5 seconds. Monsters struck with this technique will hate you more.

coreAbilities.name: Dragon's Talon
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
coreAbilities.description: You release two rending blows that deal 134 Spirit damage each, crippling your target for 4 seconds, reducing the damage they deal with every attack to 80%.

coreAbilities.name: Mighty Gale
coreAbilities.description: A strong blow dealing 156 damage to your enemy and knocking back players and knocking down monsters. Shares cooldown with Gusting Wind.

coreAbilities.name: Intimidating Blow
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
coreAbilities.description: An overpowering strike that deals 231 damage and decreases your opponent's morale by 100.

paths.name: Path of Hoeth
paths.description: A mastery path focused on magical attacks and effects.

ability.name: Calming Winds
ability.description: Increase Disrupt chance by 10% when in Normal Balance,  15% when in Improved Balance, and 20% when in Perfect balance.

ability.name: Protection of Hoeth
ability.description: You call upon the magic in your blade to form a barrier to protect you and any groupmates within 80 feet of you, absorbing up to 600 damage for up to 5 seconds.

ability.name: Blinding Strike
ability.description: Dazzling Strike will now reduce the target's chance to defend attacks by 10% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Crashing Wave
ability.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
ability.description: You launch two powerful blows dealing 175 Spirit damage with each hit and knocking your opponent down for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Blessing of Heaven
ability.description: Path of Hoeth abilities will place an effect on your target for 10 seconds. During this time, any allies who strike the target will recover 135 health over 3 seconds.

ability.name: Whispering Wind
ability.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
ability.description: You release a single swift blow damaging enemies 30 feet in front of you for 153 Spirit damage. The winds then aid group members within 100 feet for the next 10 seconds by decreasing the cooldown of abilities used by 5 seconds.

ability.name: Shadow Blades
ability.description: All enemies within 25 feet suffer 1800 damage and lose 1800 morale over 12 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Ensorcelled Blow
coreAbilities.description: A quick precision slash that calls out the enchantment in your blade dealing 156 Spirit damage.

coreAbilities.name: Dazzling Strike
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
coreAbilities.description: When your blade hits your opponent it releases a blinding flash of light that deals 306 Spirit damage, and disorients your target for 5 seconds, increasing their build times by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Wrath of Hoeth
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Improved Balance
Leads to Perfect Balance
coreAbilities.description: The magic from your blade is released in a staggering explosion that deals 170 Spirit damage to all opponents within 25 feet. In addition your opponent's Spiritual resistance will be reduced by 240 for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Gusting Wind
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Perfect Balance
Leads to Normal Balance
coreAbilities.description: You execute a quick spin, rending the air around you and producing a magical shockwave that which deals 95 Spirit damage to all opponents within 25 feet of you, knocking back enemy players and knocking down monsters.

coreAbilities.name: Heaven's Blade
coreAbilities.description:
You enchant your blade with the spirit of the heavens. All your melee attacks gain a 25% chance on hit to reduce all of your enemy's resistances by 240 for 10 seconds.

You may only have 1 Blade Enchantment active at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Deflect Oil
coreAbilities.description: 50% reduction in damage taken by Oil siege engines. You will also protect two other group mates within 30 feet. Only one effect of this type may be on a player at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Modify War Engine
coreAbilities.description: You shield the Ram absorbing 1500 damage over the next 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bulwark
coreAbilities.description: Repairs a friendly keep door for 5% of its total health over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Throw
coreAbilities.description: A basic throwing attack that inflicts 79 damage. Has a chance to deal 678 damage to a severely wounded target if you are behind them.

coreAbilities.name: Guard
coreAbilities.description:
You defend one of your groupmates and try to take attacks meant for them.  As long as you are within 30 feet of them, any damage that they suffer will be split evenly between the two of you, and 35% of all hate that they cause will be redirected to you. 

Damage received from this ability can be blocked or parried, unless the original attack was undefendable.

coreAbilities.name: Sudden Shift
coreAbilities.description:
With a graceful sweep, you quickly change your stance and prepare for battle.

   No Balance:  You gain Improved Balance.
   Improved Balance:  You gain Perfect Balance.
   Perfect Balance:  You gain Improved Balance.

coreAbilities.name: Taunt
coreAbilities.description:
You enrage your opponent, interrupting any currently building abilities and increasing their hate towards you. While taunted your opponent will take 30% more damage from your attacks. This effect will fade after 15 seconds or after your opponent has hit you 3 times.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Demolishing Strike
coreAbilities.description: A powerful melee attack that reduces  your target's armor by 1056 and deals 900 damage over 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Centuries of Training
coreAbilities.description: Upon striking a target with direct damage there is a 25% chance to inflict an additional 303 Spirit damage over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hold The Line!
coreAbilities.description:
You focus your defenses against enemy fire, increasing your chances to dodge and disrupt by 45% for 12 seconds.  You will also defend all allies behind you, up to 50 feet away, increasing their chances to dodge and disrupt by 15% as long as they remain at your back.  Allies may have this effect stacked on them up to 3 times.
This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: You become filled with unstoppable power, removing all snaring, rooting, silencing, and disarming effects. For the next 5 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Shield Wall
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, your chance to block is almost guaranteed.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Offense
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 15% more damage and all enemy monsters will hate you 15% less than normal, but your armor is reduced by 33%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Shatter Enchantment
coreAbilities.description: A shattering attack that removes one Enchantment from your enemy and deals 119 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Ensorcelled Agony
coreAbilities.description: Ensorcelled Blow will now cause an additional 365 Spirit damage over 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Rugged
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Champion's Challenge
coreAbilities.description:
Both you and your target are held tightly in place for 10 seconds, and neither one of you can move.
This effect cannot be dispelled or broken.

coreAbilities.name: Challenge
coreAbilities.description: You challenge all opponents in front of you, forcing monsters to attack you. While challenged, your opponents will deal only 70% damage to everyone other than you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bend the Winds
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Aethyric Grasp
coreAbilities.description: Roots up to 4 enemies within 25 feet of you, making them unable to move for 5 seconds. Root has a 50% chance to break whenever hit.

coreAbilities.name: Raze
coreAbilities.description: You repeatedly attack all enemies in a line in front of you, inflicting 300 damage every second  for 3 seconds, up to 65 feet away, for as long as you maintain your concentration.

coreAbilities.name: Bolstering Enchantments
coreAbilities.description: When Blade Enchants trigger they will now restore 405 health over 10 seconds to your group members within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Discerning Offense
coreAbilities.description: Your attacks have a 10% reduced chance to be defended against.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Bellow
coreAbilities.description: A loud shout that startles your target and all enemies within 25 feet of them, reducing their damage to 60% for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Menace
coreAbilities.description: Enemy monsters will hate you 100% more than normal on all attacks.

coreAbilities.name: Isha's Protection
coreAbilities.description: Heals are 20% more effective on you.

coreAbilities.name: Guard of Steel
coreAbilities.description: Protective magic increases Toughness by 120 for 20 seconds for each group member within 100 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: Juggernaut's cooldown is reduced to 40 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Potent Enchantments
coreAbilities.description: Blade Enchantments will also deal 392 Spirit damage over 9 seconds whenever they trigger.

coreAbilities.name: Wings of Heaven
coreAbilities.note:
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: You magically leap through the air towards your target.  When you land, all enemies within 25 feet around you will become snared for 10 seconds, reducing their run speed by 30%.

coreAbilities.name: Poised Attacks
coreAbilities.description: Attacks dealt from Improved or Perfect Balance are 10% harder to defend against.

coreAbilities.name: Lingering Intimidation
coreAbilities.description: Intimidating Blow will now reduce your target's chance to Critically hit by 25% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hoeth's Tempest
coreAbilities.description: Reduces the cooldown of Mighty Gale and Gusting Wind by 10 seconds. If wielding a Great Weapon, Mighty Gale additionally snares the target by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bladeshield
coreAbilities.description: You become protected by a magical shell for a few moments which will strike back at any attacker for 600 damage and absorb up to 3600 damage for up to 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Impeccable Reactions
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an attack, you will also parry the next attack. This double parry can not occur more than once every 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Adept Movements
coreAbilities.description: Improved Stance abilities now cost 35% less AP.

coreAbilities.name: Immaculate Defense
coreAbilities.description: An impressive display of defense which reduces incoming damage by 75% for both you and all group members within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.
